notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); its stake fell to 0.38% from 0.53% at year-end 2024, partly because Biocon issued about 35% more shares in FY26. CalPERS: Biocon has no U.S. listing or ADRs, so it is outside Form 13F; no CalPERS row exists in the Q3 2026 information table. Holders of record: shareholders on the register at March 31, 2026, the FY26 year end (the record's fiscal year).
